referendums.name: CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENT 1: Increasing funding to school districts
referendums.ballotLanguage: Shall the Minnesota Constitution be amended to increase the funding going to all school districts from the permanent school fund, which is a fund that supports school districts without raising individual income or property taxes, effective July 1, 2027?

referendums.name: TOWNSHIP QUESTION 1 (Alma Twp): Should the Clerk Position Be An Appointed Position Instead of An Elected Position?
referendums.ballotLanguage: Currently, the Alma Township Clerk position is an elected position that is voted on every four years.  The board would like to propose changing the Clerk position from an elected position to an appointed position.  Should the Township Clerk position be an appointed position?

referendums.name: TOWNSHIP QUESTION 1 (Fork Twp): Should the Clerk/Treasurer Position Be An Appointed Position Instead of An Elected Position?
referendums.ballotLanguage: Currently, the Fork Township Clerk/Treasurer position is an elected position that is voted on every four years. The board would like to propose changing the Clerk/Treasurer position from an elected position to an appointed position. Should the Township Clerk/Treasurer position be an appointed position?

referendums.name: SCHOOL DISTRICT QUESTION 1 (ISD #447): Approval of School District  Referendum Revenue Authorization
referendums.ballotLanguage:
The school board of Independent School District No. 447 (Grygla Public School) has proposed to increase its general education revenue by $665.15 per pupil.  The proposed referendum revenue authorization would be applicable for ten years beginning with taxes payable in 2027, and increase each year by the rate of inflation beginning with taxes payable in 2028, unless otherwise revoked or reduced as provided by law.

Shall the increase in the revenue proposed by the school board of Independent School District No. 447 be approved?

BY VOTING "YES" ON THIS BALLOT QUESTION, YOU ARE VOTING FOR A PROPERTY TAX INCREASE.
